mathematics.assertion_tested: Direct complete-window forward FIR filtering agrees with an independently indexed even/odd signal and tap split for the displayed signed Euler input and the declared finite test families; omitting the phase advance gives the displayed incorrect odd output.
mathematics.conventions: S a(n)=a(n+1); phase shift S_q b(q)=b(q+1); no padding, periodic extension, or Fourier transform; empty filters are rejected.
inputs: Signed even Euler values from the cosh reciprocal recurrence
Every unit impulse in the declared finite lengths
Six explicit tap lists stored in the program and result
non_claims: The finite tests are not a proof of the general polyphase law
No benchmark, stability, spectral convergence, new theorem, or Lean claim
